title: Fix production publish/deployment so the latest draft can be published successfully

requirements.text: Identify the root cause of the production publish/deployment failure and implement the necessary fixes so the latest draft can be deployed to production without errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Running the standard production publish/deploy flow completes successfully without a deployment error.
The deployed production app loads successfully and renders the main experience UI (lock screen → intro → hero/memories).

requirements.text: Improve deployment failure diagnostics so that if a publish/deploy fails again, the error output includes the actionable underlying cause (not only a generic "Deployment error").
acceptanceCriteria: On a failing deploy, logs include the underlying tool/command error and a clear indication of which step failed (build frontend, build canisters, deploy).
User-facing text (if any) is in English.

requirements.text: Add a pre-publish verification step to the deploy workflow to catch common publish blockers before attempting production deployment (e.g., frontend build failing, missing required artifacts, misconfigured canister/deploy settings).

quotes: 🚀 Going live with draft Version 11, now deploying to production...

acceptanceCriteria: A pre-publish check can be run locally/CI and fails fast with a clear English error message when a required build/deploy prerequisite is not met.
When all pre-publish checks pass, the subsequent production deploy succeeds using the same workflow.

constraints: Respect the single-actor backend architecture (all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo).

Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding new product features to the app UI unrelated to publishing/deployment.
Changing the existing Media Manager behavior unless required to resolve the production deployment failure.
